value.rationale: The standard examples are the canonical finite posets of unbounded order dimension. A complete symmetry-refined profile of all ways to place a fresh point relative to them is a natural model-theoretic invariant; the bivariate expression and canonical quotient classifications quantify how exponentially many individually named types collapse to quadratically many base-automorphism classes. This structural classification goes beyond a routine scalar evaluation and can serve as a benchmark for parameter symmetries and one-point extension enumeration.
